jobs.title: Business Operations Associate
jobs.description:
At Composio, we are building infrastructure that allows agents to communicate with the tools you use for work including Github, Gmail, Notion, Salesforce, etc. We are a small team of engineers wrangling problems from context to search, that help us provide the most capable bridge between your agents and your tools.

We raised a $25M Series A from Lightspeed https://lsvp.com/stories/investing-in-composio-building-the-backbone-of-ai-agent-intelligence/ with some incredible angels like Guillermo Rauch (CEO of Vercel), Dharmesh Shah (CTO of Hubspot), and Gokul Rajaram. Since the beginning of this year we have 3x'd ARR, and our customers range from your friends in the YC batch to Wabi, Glean, Zoom and many more.







WHAT YOU'LL DO?

 - build internal tooling on the fly to run our internal operations more smoothly

 - own banking, treasury and cash management, vendor negotiations

 - run core FP&A workflows: budgeting, forecasting, scenario analysis

 - support investor relations and fundraising




"MUST HAVES"

if you are very good, nothing is a must per-se

 - core business operations
   
   - you have helped scale a startup
   
   - you produce clean docs and crisp updates
   
   - you can dive into the data to surface opportunities for improving our operations

 - ai native
   
   - you are comfortable using claude code to spin up internal apps from scratch
   
   - you have bias towards working from a chat interface/cli rather than the UI

 - typist — you can write docs well and explain complex ideas clearly

 - human — you build trust and admit what you don’t know
